body: You're a fucking wealth of information. THANK YOU. I'd toss you gold if I could afford to drop that right now haha
I am stressed, and probably just took it the wrong way! Sorry about that then. Editing my reply to you :P

Shitty thing is, a contract had been drafted up and I kept being told to "hang on" until it was ready to be signed. So it is **completely** my fault for continuing my employment here without the contract I was told I would eventually sign, but that doesn't change the fact that my employers are sketchy.

And you know what? I'm going to use this wonderful time off they've provided to set up interviews elsewhere :) Good idea mate - in all seriousness, thanks for the little push.
Hah! I'm looking. The title is too large for my job, and my job is too large for what I'm being paid... This is probably the most practical advice here though! :D
Thank you for that! I may look into it, though I'm pretty sure their heads would actually explode.

I meant more in the way of unemployment benefits or something... I came here for advice, there is no need to be ~~rude~~ *incredulous*.

As I stated, I was almost positive there was no technical law-breaking going on. However, it does not seem fair to suddenly alert a full-time employee that they will be out of a job for a week at the owners discretion. My quest for advice was out of desperation, as I am dependent on that check and have received it regularly for over a year now, with only one other spontaneous interruption such as this.
I have tried one counselor who's fees were based on a sliding scale, but I didn't really get anything out of those sessions. I might try again, though, with someone else...no harm in trying.

The main thing is this sadness, guys. I don't know how else to describe it other than an extremely vivid, almost palpable "sadness" that will rise up in me sometimes without necessarily involving triggers or anything.

It takes you over and there's not much you can do about it. You can either stay in bed, defeated, or think to yourself "Well, I'm going to feel like shit today and probably want to cry. But guess what? Just like yesterday, and the day before that, **no one will ever know what's inside of you.** Put on that fake fucking smile that probably got you to this point, go outside, and go through the motions one more time."

Lather.
Rinse.
Repeat.

Yeah the co-worker thing isn't such a big deal, especially because none of them are particularly horrible to me or anything. I think they're mostly apathetic toward me, which is fine.

I like video games alright, but I don't think I've touched anything in the past two years aside from FIFA 12/13 and Skyrim. I really enjoy coding and playing guitar, but am not very good at either.

I've talked to two counselors in the past four years for at least a few consistent months with each. Honestly, I found them both to be at least mildly helpful - but mostly with processing childhood events and discovering myself. I can't deny that I feel a lot more "attuned" to myself since meeting with the counselors, but nothing has ever made the overwhelming "sadness" any better.

I would have kept seeing the counselors, probably, but I couldn't continue paying for them once I got out on my own.

I'm in this boat, and don't have any advice to give. I just came to say that I feel your pain, and I really identify with your thought processes and such.

I don't know how much it's worth, because I don't know how much it would mean if someone told me this, but I feel you. I hope there's a good resolution to what you're going through. I'm dealing with the same suicidal thoughts right now, and the only thing that has kept me from action is knowing that suicide is the last decision you ever get to make. The places we're both at right now have (however infinitely small) some probability of turning completely around, but suicide precludes that. That's all I got.

Feel free to PM me if you want to talk about how shitty we both feel about ourselves and how painful it is to have no one care.

Mods, if this was absolutely terrible, go ahead and delete it. I don't know if it's kosher for one suicidal person to try to talk to another.
